description.value: At 1st level, a gambler can invoke the power of luck to enhance his allies' abilities by casting an ephemeral die. The gambler begins play knowing six Phantom Rolls, gaining an additional Phantom Roll at 4th level and every three gambler levels thereafter (4th, 7th, 10th, 13th, 16th, 19th). As a swift action, the gambler selects a known Phantom Roll, then chooses any number of allies within 20 feet (including himself) to affect, expending one use for each creature affected, then rolls 1d6 to determine the strength of the bonus (base bonus on 1-5, lucky bonus on a 6). The base/lucky/unlucky bonuses scale with gambler level: +3/+5/+1 at 1st, +4/+6/+2 at 5th, +5/+7/+2 at 9th, +6/+9/+3 at 13th, +7/+10/+3 at 17th. The gambler can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 10 + his Charisma modifier, plus 2 additional uses per level beyond 1st. Double-Up: At 2nd level, the gambler can 'double-up' his 1d6 roll, rolling additional 1d6s as a free action (summing all dice, provided the total does not exceed 11, or he busts). A total of 7, 9, or 10 applies the base bonus; a total of 8 applies the unlucky bonus; a total of 11 applies the lucky bonus and prevents the next bust from forfeiting all effects.
